[[File:Datadisk.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A holodisc]]
A '''hologram disc''', also called a '''holodisk''', '''holotape''' or '''holodisc,''' was a device onto which [[holograph]]ic messages, as well as [[Hologram/Legends|hologrammic]] ones, could be recorded. It was possible to encrypt the content of a holodisc.

==History==
[[File:Hologram_disc.png|thumb|right|250px|Padmé Amidala conceals a hologram disc from Rush Clovis]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] went on a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|mission to Cato Neimoidia]] where she procured a hologram disc of a new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] droid foundry that the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] was funding. This was proof that exposed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] of the Banking Clan of conspiring with the Separatists.<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref>

[[Morgan Katarn]] had recorded a message to his son [[Kyle Katarn|Kyle]] revealing the location of the [[Map to the Valley of the Jedi|map]] to the [[Valley of the Jedi]] and the truth about Kyle's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] potential, and encrypted its content. Only [[WeeGee]] could decrypt it, though Rebel computer wizard [[Wires]] managed to decrypt it for [[Jan Ors]] so that the holorecording could be played at very low quality.

[[0 BBY/Legends|Shortly before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a copy of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] was obtained through a [[Death Star Uprising|prison riot]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Rebel prisoners managed to steal a copy of the Death Star plans and beam it to a Rebel cell stationed at a [[Polis Massa Research Base|base]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]]. These plans would be transferred to a holodisc, and this holodisc would play a key role during the subsequent [[Raid on Polis Massa|Imperial raid on Polis Massa]]. When Imperial forces stormed a command room located further in the base, they retrieved the holodisc. After returning it to a captured communications center, they were forced to hold off Rebel forces for a couple minutes as the computer needed time to uplink the data to the Imperial network. During this, the Empire discovered that this holodisc was a decoy, but it did lead [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to the whereabouts of the plans, which were now in a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] in the custody of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].
